text:
sara-recruiter: Heads up team 1 new grad offer accepted, flying in for orientation Mon. Hiring manager asked if we can advance travel + 2 nights hotel. Can we?

emma-peopleops: Welcome! We can do an advance for onboarding travel but need the Onboarding Travel Advance form filled out and hiring manager approval.

sara-recruiter: Link? I need to get this booked today.

emma-peopleops: Form: https://intranet.redwood/corp/expenses/onboarding-advance. Checklist: requestor, new hire name, start date, estimate (air + hotel + ground), payment method, manager approver.

jon-finance: Policy notes: max advance $1,000 for onboarding unless exec signoff. Hotel cap $200/night for new hire onboarding; per-diem $60/day. Receipts required. Advances must be reconciled within 5 business days after the last travel date.

max-hiringops: If new hire needs vendor setup for ACH, that can add 48 hours. If timeline is tight, we can issue a temporary check or pay card. Please indicate preferred payment option on the form.

expense-bot: Auto-check: onboarding advances flagged to cost_center: recruiting and project_code: onboarding. Alcohol excluded; upgrades need pre-approval.

emma-peopleops: Quick tip: to speed things up, include the signed offer and start date in the form and ask manager to approve in the same email thread. Finance can cut an emergency check same-day if approved before 2pm.

sara-recruiter: Submitted form and attached offer. Manager approved by reply. Prefer ACH.

emma-peopleops: Got it. Finance will process ACH; expect funds within 2 business days. Remember to remind the new hire to keep itemized receipts and submit expense report within 5 business days after travel.

jon-finance: Processing now. Ticket ONB-2026-77 created. Reconcile instructions included in the confirmation email.

sara-recruiter: Perfect 1 thanks everyone.

expense-bot: Ticket ONB-2026-77 created and assigned. Reconcile deadline: 5 business days after travel end.
